_comment: Browser matbot config (the matbot.yaml analogue, as JSON so the node assembler needs no YAML parser). Plugin entries are repo-relative package paths; the assembler resolves them to inlined modules. `providers` is intentionally empty — the browser asks for the full provider config (name, adapter, URL, model, key) at first startup and persists it. `providerModules` are the adapters that wizard offers. Only browser-safe plugins are listed — bash/docker/mcp/skills and the node web frontend require Node and are omitted.

providerModules.label: OpenAI-compatible chat completions (GPT, DeepSeek, Azure, local)
